name: gauges
description: A live pane for Claude Code: context, pace-based limits with ETA, the week, cost, repo and PR, and a roster of every local session

warnPercent.title: Warn at (%)
warnPercent.description: Context or a usage limit at or above this turns amber and toasts once

highPercent.title: High at (%)
highPercent.description: Context or a usage limit at or above this turns red and toasts once

style.title: Style
style.description: plain: a dry line on context and what to do. playful: Claude's mood (bedtime, breaks, boredom), a cat whose face follows context, a critter per session. sassy: the same, PG-13 and sardonic. discworld: the same, from Ankh-Morpork, with the Luggage in the toasts

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: system: gauges animate briefly when a value changes, unless the OS asks for reduced motion. off: never

terminalStatus.title: Terminal status line
terminalStatus.description: Show needs-you and off-pace limits in the terminal's status area. Leave off when statusline.sh from this repo owns the terminal
